submission_method.quote: Proposals must be submitted electronically through BC Bid meet the requirements in Section 4.2. Respondents must use the submission method set out in this Section 4.3. Submissions by any other delivery method WILL NOT be accepted.

contract_term.quote: TERM. The initial term of the Contract is expected to be for three years. WorkSafeBC will have the right in its sole discretion to renew the Contract for up to two further three-year term.

scope_of_deliverables.quote: SCOPE OF SERVICES. The scope of services shall include the following (collectively, the “Services”): (a) Test Platform: An integrated web-based test platform (the “Solution”) that: (i) Supports various types of assessments (i.e., multiple choice, simulations) securely and efficiently; (ii) Provides participant (i.e., exam takers) registration into the Solution; (iii) Provides invigilation and proctoring of online assessments with real-time support for exam takers and training providers;
scope_of_deliverables.value: The RFP seeks an end-to-end solution for exam development and administration, including a web-based testing platform, online invigilation, competency framework development, and exam psychometric support services, along with related implementation, support, and maintenance services.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: Respondents must provide their submission to WorkSafeBC via BC Bid as follows: (a) Electronic submissions via BC Bid must meet the following requirements: (i) submissions must be made using Microsoft Office 2007 or later or Adobe PDF format; (ii) each file should be less than 20MB. Failure by any Respondent to comply with this restriction may result in information not being received by WorkSafeBC and may result in a non-compliant Proposal by the Respondent; and (iii) ZIP or like files will not be accepted.
value: submissions must be made using Microsoft Office 2007 or later or Adobe PDF format
each file should be less than 20MB
ZIP or like files will not be accepted

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote: (a) Web-Based Testing Platform: The Solution must include a web-based testing platform that: (i) Supports multiple question types (e.g., multiple choice, short answer, essay); (ii) Provides a secure and user-friendly interface for candidates and administrators; (iii) Allows for the creation, administration, and scoring of exams; (iv) Has tools and functionalities that provide statistical analysis of assessments (i.e., psychometric analysis of exam and test bank items), reporting and data analytics capabilities, item writing/review, and item banking; and (v) Has the ability to do daily data transfer of participant registration details and test results to WorkSafeBC’s Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform.

data_security_requirements.quote: 3.4 PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS. WorkSafeBC is a public body subject to FIPPA. All service providers to WorkSafeBC are also subject to FIPPA in the performance of services, regardless of their jurisdiction or privacy policies otherwise in place.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Phase three - Demonstration: Based on the results of the phase two evaluation, WorkSafeBC will select and invite the top two scoring Respondents from phase two evaluation to participate in phase three. In the event that there are two or more tied scores, WorkSafeBC reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of Respondents invited to present.
